title: Brookfield Infrastructure Announces Completion of Corporate Simplification
summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Announces Completion of Corporate Simplification
body_markdown:
BROOKFIELD, NEWS, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brookfield Infrastructure today announced the creation of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (“BIP Inc.”), marking the successful completion of its corporate simplification. BIP Inc. combines Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. (“BIP”) and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation (“BIPC”) into a single corporate entity.


The court-approved plan of arrangement became effective today and existing securityholders of BIP and BIPC received class A subordinate voting shares (“Class A Shares”) of BIP Inc. on a one-for one basis. BIP Inc. Class A Shares are expected to commence trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) and the Toronto Stock Exchange (the “TSX”) under the symbol “BIP” on November 23, 2026.


The Board of Directors of BIP Inc. declared a quarterly dividend on the BIP Inc. Class A Shares in the amount of US$0.455 per Class A Share, payable on December 31, 2026 to shareholders of record as at the close of business on November 30, 2026.


Upon closing, BIP Inc. assumed BIP’s existing normal course issuer bid and may repurchase up to 23,062,017 Class A Shares (less any BIP Units repurchased by BIP prior to the date hereof) through the facilities of the TSX, the NYSE and/or alternative trading systems until December 1, 2026.


BIP Inc. adopted a dividend reinvestment plan for the Class A Shares that is substantially similar to BIP’s plan. Registered unitholders who participated in BIP’s plan prior to its termination on November 5, 2026 will be required to confirm their enrollment in the BIP Inc. plan by May 19, 2027, and non-registered holders should contact their broker.


BIP’s preferred units, series 9 and 11 remain listed on the TSX and trade under the symbols BIPF.PR.E and BIPF.PR.F, respectively. BIP’s preferred units, series 13 and 14 remain listed on the NYSE and trade under the symbols BIPF PRA and BIPF PRB, respectively. The preferred units, series 19 of Brookfield Infrastructure L.P. remain listed on the TSX and trade under the symbol BILP.PR.A.


**About Brookfield Infrastructure**
Brookfield Infrastructure is a leading global infrastructure company that owns and operates high-quality, long-life assets in the utilities, transport, midstream and data sectors across the Americas, Asia Pacific and Europe. We are focused on assets that have contracted and regulated revenues that generate predictable and stable cash flows. Investors can access its portfolio through Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (NYSE, TSX: BIP), a Canadian corporation. Further information is available at[https://bip.brookfield.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ebj5zPKEpiRR3Rm186_k_0FlRsAxShANmJdp65B_wCFTRru9ydLdBeO_gUu-ZKerkei3oSkGnHZka9WyZSBjsr_eIXR7t2qcTr86rjioV5k=) .


Brookfield Infrastructure is the flagship listed infrastructure company of Brookfield Asset Management, a global alternative asset manager, headquartered in New York with over US$1 trillion of assets under management.
